summary: Official BTV page is live, but applications are currently closed and no future application window or cohort dates are published. Proposed event omitted until current cadence is public.

sources.title: The Mint by BTV
sources.supports: Official page states The Mint is a pre-seed platform for fintech founders, shows applications closed, describes 10 curated weeks of in-person support, Demo Day, mentorship, workshops, and BTV access.

sources.title: We're Launching an Accelerator!
sources.supports: Official launch post identifies The Mint as a BTV accelerator, says the first cohort started in San Francisco on Aug 1, 2023, and describes the original $500k for 10% terms and three-month San Francisco-based format.

notes: The official application link currently appears as 'Applications closed' on the BTV page.
Existing public cohort information on the official page lists Fall 2023 and Spring 2024 cohort companies, but no 2026 cohort or application deadline is published.
Because there is no current application window or future cohort cadence, this should remain needs_review rather than a mergeable current event.
